nextStoryContext: US-005 made two doc-accuracy fixes across BOTH templated copies (.claude/commands/ + templates/commands/), regenerated via `bun run embed-vendor` (src/vendor/_generated.ts): (1) cam-plan.md's Argument-N example now shows the N-padded filename `CAM-0151.json` (was `CAM-151.json`), consistent with the surrounding N-padded rule text already present; (2) cam-spec.md now documents `cam spec --write-docs`'s success stdout contract `CAM_DOMAIN_DOCS_WRITTEN=<id> sha=<sha>` (mirrors the existing `CAM_SPEC_RESULT=` contract shown for --persist; ground truth spec.ts:320) and adds `missing-main` to the two existing diverged/detached-head error-table rows (ground truth issue-specify.ts's SpecifyIssueOnMainError union, reason: 'missing-main'). Both file pairs were byte-identical outside these lines per the dual-copy gotcha (memory cam-dual-copy-is-per-lines-per-file), diffed before editing. No behavior change, no TS touched, no new test needed (existing embedded.test.ts / vendor hygiene suite already covers content drift for these files and stayed green). US-006 (next story) targets subagent-implementer.md's PRD_COMPLETE row and a dead cam-review section -- different templated files (.claude/agents/ or .claude/commands/cam-review.md family), no shared state with US-005.
